AcquisitionOfBeneficialOwnershipResult.description: One Schedule 13D/13G beneficial-ownership change for one company. Returned by `acquisition_of_beneficial_ownership()`.

ActivelyTradingListResult.description: One symbol currently actively traded, across all asset classes. Returned by `actively_trading_list()`.

AdxResult.description: One bar of average directional index, with its OHLCV base fields.

AnalystEstimatesResult.description: Consensus revenue/EPS/margin forecast for one period. Returned by `analyst_estimates()`.

AvailableCountryResult.description: One country code usable for filtering elsewhere in the API. Returned by `available_countries()`.

AvailableExchangeResult.description: One exchange FMP has data for. Returned by `available_exchanges()`.

AvailableIndustryResult.description: One industry value usable for filtering elsewhere in the API. Returned by `available_industries()`.

AvailableSectorResult.description: One sector value usable for filtering elsewhere in the API (e.g. `company_screener`'s `sector` parameter). Returned by `available_sectors()`.

BalanceSheetStatementAsReportedResult.description: Balance sheet data exactly as filed, XBRL tag names as keys. Returned by `balance_sheet_statement_as_reported()`.

BalanceSheetStatementBulkResult.description: Balance sheet for every company, for one fiscal period. Returned by `balance_sheet_statement_bulk()`.

BalanceSheetStatementGrowthBulkResult.description: Balance sheet growth for every company, for one fiscal period. Returned by `balance_sheet_statement_growth_bulk()`.

BalanceSheetStatementGrowthResult.description: Year-over-year growth rate for every balance-sheet line item. Returned by `balance_sheet_statement_growth()`.

BalanceSheetStatementResult.description: `balance_sheet_statement` only — not shared with `balance_sheet_statement_ttm`: the TTM documented example is missing `capitalLeaseObligationsNonCurrent`, a genuine (if narrow) shape difference, not just a scope change.

BalanceSheetStatementTtmResult.description: `balance_sheet_statement_ttm` only — see `BalanceSheetStatementResult` for why this isn't shared.

CashFlowStatementAsReportedResult.description: Cash flow data exactly as filed, XBRL tag names as keys. Returned by `cash_flow_statement_as_reported()`.

CashFlowStatementBulkResult.description: Cash flow statement for every company, for one fiscal period. Returned by `cash_flow_statement_bulk()`.

CashFlowStatementGrowthBulkResult.description: 3 fields keep FMP's own typo verbatim — `...Activites`, missing the second `i` — matching the real documented response, not `cash_flow_statement_bulk`'s correctly-spelled `...ProvidedByOperatingActivities`/etc. Don't "fix" these; it would break the cast against real JSON.

CashFlowStatementGrowthResult.description: Year-over-year growth rate for every cash-flow-statement line item. Returned by `cash_flow_statement_growth()`.

CashFlowStatementResult.description: Shape shared by `cash_flow_statement` (periodic) and `cash_flow_statement_ttm` (trailing twelve months) — identical fields in both documented examples, same question at different scope.

CikListResult.description: One SEC CIK on file. Returned by `cik_list()`.

CommitmentOfTradersAnalysisResult.description: Derived sentiment analysis (bullish/bearish market situation, net position change, reversal-trend flag) built on top of the raw COT report. Returned by `commitment_of_traders_analysis()`.

CommitmentOfTradersListResult.description: One symbol a COT report is available for. Returned by `commitment_of_traders_list()`.

CommitmentOfTradersReportResult.description: CFTC Commitment of Traders report, one row per market per date. ~140 fields, fully typed. Field names are verbatim from FMP's own response, including its `Spead`/`Spread` and `netPostion` typos — not corrected here, since fixing them would break parsing a real response.

CommoditiesListResult.description: One tradable commodity FMP tracks, with symbol, trade month, and currency. Returned by `commodities_list()`.

CompanyNotesResult.description: One corporate debt note the company has issued, with exchange listing. Returned by `company_notes()`.

CompanyScreenerResult.description: One company matching the screener's filter criteria. Returned by `company_screener()`.

CongressionalTradeResult.description: One financial disclosure record, from either a House or Senate filing. Shared by `house_latest`, `house_trades`, `house_trades_by_id`, `house_trades_by_name`, `senate_latest`, `senate_trades`, `senate_trades_by_id`, `senate_trades_by_name`. Note the `senateID` field is used on House rows too — that's FMP's own naming, not a typo in this SDK.

CrowdfundingOfferingResult.description: Shape shared by `crowdfunding_offerings` (one issuer's campaigns by CIK) and `crowdfunding_offerings_latest` (market-wide, paginated) — identical fields in both documented examples.

CrowdfundingOfferingSearchResult.description: One issuer matching a Reg CF campaign name search, resolving to a CIK. Returned by `crowdfunding_offerings_search()`.

CryptocurrencyListResult.description: One cryptocurrency FMP tracks, with symbol, name, exchange, and supply data. Returned by `cryptocurrency_list()`.

CustomDiscountedCashFlowResult.description: One year of the projection built by `custom_discounted_cash_flow()` — revenue/EBITDA/EBIT build-up, WACC components, and per-year valuation detail, using your overridden assumptions where given.

CustomLeveredDiscountedCashFlowResult.description: One year of the projection built by `custom_levered_discounted_cash_flow()` — same idea as `CustomDiscountedCashFlowResult`, levered (net of debt).

DelistedCompanyResult.description: One company removed from public exchanges. Returned by `delisted_companies()`.

DemaResult.description: One bar of double exponential moving average, with its OHLCV base fields.

EarningCallTranscriptDatesResult.description: One fiscal year/quarter a company has an earnings-call transcript on file for. Returned by `earning_call_transcript_dates()`.

EarningCallTranscriptLatestResult.description: One recent earnings-call transcript, across all companies. Returned by `earning_call_transcript_latest()`.

EarningCallTranscriptResult.description: Full text of one earnings call for one fiscal quarter. Returned by `earning_call_transcript()`.

EarningsResult.description: Shape shared by `earnings` (one company's history) and `earnings_calendar` (market-wide, one date range) — same rationale as `DividendResult`.

EarningsSurprisesBulkResult.description: Actual vs. estimated EPS for every company, for one fiscal year. Returned by `earnings_surprises_bulk()`.

EarningsTranscriptListResult.description: Also reachable as `client.directory.earnings_transcript_list` — FMP documents this endpoint under both "Directory" and "Earnings Transcripts".

EconomicCalendarResult.description: One scheduled economic data release, with prior/estimate/actual values once reported. Requires an FMP Starter-tier plan or higher. Returned by `economic_calendar()`.

EconomicIndicatorsResult.description: One macroeconomic series (GDP, CPI, unemployment, etc.) value at one date. Returned by `economic_indicators()`.

EmaResult.description: One bar of exponential moving average, with its OHLCV base fields.

EmployeeCountResult.description: Shape shared by `employee_count` (latest filing) and `historical_employee_count` (full history) — identical fields in both documented examples, same question at different scope.

EnterpriseValuesResult.description: Market cap plus debt minus cash, for one period. Returned by `enterprise_values()`.

EodBulkResult.description: End-of-day OHLCV price for every symbol, on one date. Returned by `eod_bulk()`.

EsgBenchmarkResult.description: Average ESG scores for one sector, for cross-company benchmarking. Returned by `esg_benchmark()`.

EsgDisclosuresResult.description: One per-filing environmental/social/governance score set from an SEC disclosure. Returned by `esg_disclosures()`.

EsgRatingsResult.description: Current ESG risk rating and industry rank for one company. Returned by `esg_ratings()`.

EtfAssetExposureResult.description: Different shape from `EtfHoldingsResult` despite the overlapping field names: this answers "which ETFs hold this asset" (one row per ETF), not "what does this ETF hold" (one row per asset) — no `name`/`isin`/`securityCusip` in the documented example.

EtfCountryWeightingsResult.description: Portfolio weight by country of an ETF's underlying holdings. Returned by `etf_country_weightings()`.

EtfHolderBulkResult.description: ETF holdings for a whole page of the universe at once. Returned by `etf_holder_bulk()`.

EtfHoldingsResult.description: One asset an ETF holds, with market value and portfolio weight. Returned by `etf_holdings()`.

EtfInfoResult.description: Fund-level metadata: expense ratio, AUM, NAV, inception date, and sector exposure breakdown. Returned by `etf_info()`.

EtfListResult.description: One ETF symbol FMP tracks. Returned by `etf_list()`.

EtfSectorWeightingsResult.description: Portfolio weight by sector of an ETF's underlying holdings. Returned by `etf_sector_weightings()`.

ExchangeMarketHoursResult.description: Shape shared by `exchange_market_hours` (one exchange) and `all_exchange_market_hours` (every exchange) — identical fields.

ExecutiveCompensationBenchmarkResult.description: Average executive compensation for one industry, for cross-company benchmarking. Returned by `executive_compensation_benchmark()`.

ExecutiveCompensationResult.description: One executive's detailed compensation filing: salary, bonus, stock/option awards, total. Returned by `governance_executive_compensation()`.

FinancialGrowthResult.description: Cross-statement growth metrics (revenue, margins, per-share trends over 3/5/10 years). Returned by `financial_growth()`.

FinancialReportsDatesResult.description: One fiscal year/period FMP has a 10-K report for, with links to the JSON and XLSX forms. Returned by `financial_reports_dates()`.

FinancialScoresResult.description: Altman Z-Score and Piotroski Score, for bankruptcy-risk and financial-strength assessment. Returned by `financial_scores()`.

FinancialStatementFullAsReportedResult.description: Like the three single-statement `*AsReportedResult` types, but `data` here is genuinely heterogeneous in the documented example — strings, boolean-as-string, and numbers side by side (this is the combined income+balance+cashflow filing, XBRL tag soup). Typed loosely on purpose, not an oversight.

FinancialStatementSymbolListResult.description: One symbol FMP has financial statements available for. Returned by `financial_statement_symbol_list()`.

FmpArticlesResult.description: One of FMP's own editorial articles. Returned by `fmp_articles()`.

ForexListResult.description: One currency pair FMP tracks, with symbol and base/counter currency names. Returned by `forex_list()`.

FundraisingResult.description: Shape shared by `fundraising` (one issuer's Reg D filings by CIK) and `fundraising_latest` (market-wide, paginated) — identical fields in both documented examples.

FundraisingSearchResult.description: One issuer matching a Reg D/A company name search, resolving to a CIK. Returned by `fundraising_search()`.

FundsDisclosureDatesResult.description: One filing period available for `funds_disclosure()`, for one fund. Returned by `funds_disclosure_dates()`.

FundsDisclosureHoldersLatestResult.description: One fund's most recent disclosed holding of one security, with share count and change since the prior filing. Returned by `funds_disclosure_holders_latest()`.

FundsDisclosureHoldersSearchResult.description: One fund/entity matching a name search, with CIK, series/class IDs, and filer address. Returned by `funds_disclosure_holders_search()`.

FundsDisclosureResult.description: One N-PORT-style per-holding disclosure line for one fund, one filing period. Returned by `funds_disclosure()`.

GradesConsensusResult.description: Current consensus grade counts and overall consensus label (e.g. ``"Buy"``). Returned by `grades_consensus()`.

GradesHistoricalResult.description: Dated counts of strong-buy/buy/hold/sell/strong-sell ratings in force, one row per date. Returned by `grades_historical()`.

GradesResult.description: One analyst grading action (upgrade, downgrade, maintain). Returned by `grades()`.

HistoricalChartResult.description: Response for `historical_chart`'s intraday timeframes (`1min`/`5min`/`15min`/`30min`/`1hour`/`4hour`). No `symbol` field — unlike every other chart shape, since you already know which symbol you asked for.

HistoricalIndexConstituentResult.description: Shape shared by `historical_sp500_constituent`, `historical_nasdaq_constituent`, and `historical_dowjones_constituent` — same rationale as `IndexConstituentResult`.

HistoricalPriceEodDividendAdjustedResult.description: See `HistoricalPriceEodNonSplitAdjustedResult` — same shape, deliberately separate type.

HistoricalPriceEodFullResult.description: Full daily OHLCV plus change and VWAP. Returned by `historical_price_eod_full()`.

HistoricalPriceEodLightResult.description: Daily close price and volume only, no OHLC. Returned by `historical_price_eod_light()`.

HistoricalPriceEodNonSplitAdjustedResult.description: Same field set as `HistoricalPriceEodDividendAdjustedResult`, but kept as a separate type: split-adjustment and dividend-adjustment answer different questions about "true" price, so don't assume the two are interchangeable even though the shape matches.

HolidaysByExchangeResult.description: One non-trading holiday date for one exchange, with any adjusted open/close times. Returned by `holidays_by_exchange()`.

IncomeStatementAsReportedResult.description: Outer shape shared structurally with `BalanceSheetStatementAsReportedResult` and `CashFlowStatementAsReportedResult` (same `{..., data: dict}` wrapper) but kept as a separate named type — different statement, different question, same precedent as the EOD-adjustment types above.

IncomeStatementBulkResult.description: Income statement for every company, for one fiscal period. Returned by `income_statement_bulk()`.

IncomeStatementGrowthBulkResult.description: Income statement growth for every company, for one fiscal period. Returned by `income_statement_growth_bulk()`.

IncomeStatementGrowthResult.description: Year-over-year growth rate for every income-statement line item. Returned by `income_statement_growth()`.

IncomeStatementResult.description: Shape shared by `income_statement` (periodic) and `income_statement_ttm` (trailing twelve months) — identical fields in both documented examples, same question at different scope.

IndexConstituentResult.description: Shape shared by `sp500_constituent`, `nasdaq_constituent`, and `dowjones_constituent` — same question (current index membership) at different index scope, identical fields in all three documented examples.

IndexListResult.description: One stock market index FMP tracks, with symbol, name, exchange, and currency. Returned by `index_list()`.

IndustryClassificationResult.description: Shape shared by `all_industry_classification` and `industry_classification_search` — same question (industry classification lookup) at different scope (whole universe vs. filtered by symbol/cik/sicCode). See `SecFilingsCompanySearchResult` for the structurally-identical-but-different-question sibling this is deliberately kept apart from.

IndustryPeResult.description: Shape shared by `industry_pe_snapshot` (one date) and `historical_industry_pe` (a date range) — identical fields.

IndustryPerformanceResult.description: Shape shared by `industry_performance_snapshot` (one date) and `historical_industry_performance` (a date range) — identical fields.

InsiderTradingReportingNameResult.description: One insider matching a filed-name search, resolving to a reporting CIK. Returned by `insider_trading_reporting_name()`.

InsiderTradingResult.description: Shape shared by `insider_trading_latest` and `insider_trading_search` — identical fields in both documented examples.

InsiderTradingStatisticsResult.description: Quarterly insider buy/sell totals and acquired/disposed ratio for one company. Returned by `insider_trading_statistics()`.

InsiderTradingTransactionTypeResult.description: One SEC Form 4 transaction type code FMP recognizes. Returned by `insider_trading_transaction_type()`.

InstitutionalOwnershipDatesResult.description: One fiscal year/quarter one filer has a Form 13F on file for. Returned by `institutional_ownership_dates()`.

InstitutionalOwnershipExtractAnalyticsHo.description: Per-holder analytics for one security: weight, market value and share-count changes, ownership percentage, holding period. Returned by `institutional_ownership_extract_analytics_holder()`.

InstitutionalOwnershipExtractResult.description: One security in one filer's Form 13F holdings for one quarter. Returned by `institutional_ownership_extract()`.

InstitutionalOwnershipHolderIndustryBrea.description: One filer's portfolio weight and performance for one industry. Returned by `institutional_ownership_holder_industry_breakdown()`.

InstitutionalOwnershipHolderPerformanceS.description: One filer's portfolio performance, including S&P 500-relative returns over 1/3/5 years and since inception. Returned by `institutional_ownership_holder_performance_summary()`.

InstitutionalOwnershipIndustrySummaryRes.description: Total institutional investment value for one industry, market-wide. Returned by `institutional_ownership_industry_summary()`.

InstitutionalOwnershipLatestResult.description: One recent Form 13F filing, across all institutional investors. Returned by `institutional_ownership_latest()`.

InstitutionalOwnershipSymbolPositionsSum.description: Aggregate institutional positioning in one security: investor count, share/value totals, new/increased/reduced/closed position counts, put/call ratio. Returned by `institutional_ownership_symbol_positions_summary()`.

IposCalendarResult.description: One upcoming or recent IPO. Returned by `ipos_calendar()`.

IposDisclosureResult.description: One SEC IPO disclosure filing. Returned by `ipos_disclosure()`.

IposProspectusResult.description: One SEC IPO prospectus filing, with offering-price detail. Returned by `ipos_prospectus()`.

KeyExecutiveResult.description: One member of company leadership: name, title, pay, and demographic detail. Returned by `key_executives()`.

KeyMetricsResult.description: Valuation and efficiency metrics (EV multiples, ROIC, cash conversion cycle, ...) for one company, one period. Returned by `key_metrics()`.

KeyMetricsTtmBulkResult.description: Trailing-twelve-month key metrics for every company at once. Returned by `key_metrics_ttm_bulk()`.

KeyMetricsTtmResult.description: Not shared with `KeyMetricsResult`: every field carries a `TTM` suffix and the date/fiscalYear/period/reportedCurrency fields are dropped entirely — a genuinely different shape, not just a scope change.

LatestFinancialStatementsResult.description: One company with a newly filed financial statement. Requires an FMP Ultimate-tier plan — 402s on free, Starter, and Premium (confirmed working on Ultimate 2026-08-24). Returned by `latest_financial_statements()`.

MarketCapResult.description: Shape shared by `market_capitalization` (one symbol, latest), `market_capitalization_batch` (many symbols, latest), and `historical_market_capitalization` (one symbol, date range) — identical fields in all three documented examples, same question at different scope.

MarketMoverResult.description: Shape shared by `biggest_gainers`, `biggest_losers`, and `most_actives` — same question (a ranked list of stocks) at different ranking criteria, identical fields in all three documented examples.

MarketRiskPremiumResult.description: Country risk premium and total equity risk premium for one country. Returned by `market_risk_premium()`.

MergersAcquisitionsResult.description: Shape shared by `mergers_acquisitions_latest` (recent, unfiltered) and `mergers_acquisitions_search` (filtered by company name) — identical fields in both documented examples, same question at different scope.

NewsArticleResult.description: Shape shared by all 9 remaining `client.news` methods (`news_general_latest`, `news_press_releases`/`_latest`, `news_stock`/`_latest`, `news_crypto`/`_latest`, `news_forex`/ `_latest`) — identical fields in every documented example; the `symbols*`-taking "search" variants and their "-latest" siblings answer the same question (a news article) at different scope (one symbol vs. market-wide).

OwnerEarningsResult.description: Buffett-style owner earnings (net income adjusted for maintenance vs. growth capex). Returned by `owner_earnings()`.

PeersBulkResult.description: Peer-company list for every company at once. Returned by `peers_bulk()`.

PriceTargetConsensusResult.description: High/low/median/consensus analyst price targets. Returned by `price_target_consensus()`.

PriceTargetSummaryBulkResult.description: Analyst price-target summary (last month/quarter/year/all-time) for every company at once. Returned by `price_target_summary_bulk()`.

PriceTargetSummaryResult.description: Average analyst price targets over the last month/quarter/year/ all-time, with publisher list. Returned by `price_target_summary()`.

ProfileBulkResult.description: Company profile for a whole page ("part") of the universe at once. Same field set as `ProfileResult` (`profile`/`profile_cik`), but every value is a `str` — this is a CSV response, unlike the single-company JSON endpoints. Returned by `profile_bulk()`.

ProfileResult.description: Shape shared by `profile` (lookup by symbol) and `profile_cik` (lookup by CIK) — identical fields in both documented examples, and both answer the same question (the company profile record), just keyed differently.

QuoteResult.description: Shape shared by `quote` and `batch_quote` — identical fields.

QuoteShortResult.description: Condensed quote shape (price/change/volume only) shared by `quote_short` and every `batch_*` quote method: `batch_quote_short`, `batch_exchange_quote`, `batch_etf_quotes`, `batch_mutualfund_quotes`, `batch_commodity_quotes`, `batch_crypto_quotes`, `batch_forex_quotes`, `batch_index_quotes`.

RatingBulkResult.description: Current overall rating and component scores for every company at once. Returned by `rating_bulk()`.

RatingsHistoricalResult.description: Same score fields as `RatingsSnapshotResult` plus `date`, but kept separate: a point-in-time snapshot and a dated history entry answer different questions even where every other field lines up.

RatingsSnapshotResult.description: Current overall rating and per-factor scores (DCF, ROE, ROA, debt/equity, P/E, P/B). Returned by `ratings_snapshot()`.

RatiosResult.description: Profitability, liquidity, efficiency, and leverage ratios for one company, one period. Returned by `ratios()`.

RatiosTtmBulkResult.description: Trailing-twelve-month financial ratios for every company at once. Returned by `ratios_ttm_bulk()`.

RatiosTtmResult.description: Not shared with `RatiosResult`: every field carries a `TTM` suffix and date/fiscalYear/period/reportedCurrency are dropped — a genuinely different shape, not just a scope change.

RevenueGeographicSegmentationResult.description: Revenue broken down by geographic region, for one fiscal period. Returned by `revenue_geographic_segmentation()`.

RevenueProductSegmentationResult.description: Outer shape structurally identical to `RevenueGeographicSegmentationResult` but kept separate: product-line vs. geographic revenue breakdown are different questions, same precedent as the EOD-adjustment types above.

RsiResult.description: One bar of relative strength index, with its OHLCV base fields.

ScoresBulkResult.description: Altman Z-Score, Piotroski score, and related financial-health metrics for every company at once. Returned by `scores_bulk()`.

SearchCikResult.description: One identity record resolved from a CIK search. Returned by `search_cik()`.

SearchCusipResult.description: One identity record resolved from a CUSIP search. Returned by `search_cusip()`.

SearchExchangeVariantsResult.description: One exchange listing of a symbol, with a full profile record for that listing. Returned by `search_exchange_variants()`.

SearchIsinResult.description: One identity record resolved from an ISIN search. Returned by `search_isin()`.

SearchSymbolResult.description: Shape shared by `search_symbol` and `search_name` (identical in both documented examples).

SecFilingResult.description: Shape shared by `sec_filings_8k` and `sec_filings_financials` — identical fields, including `hasFinancials` (absent from the `sec_filings_search_*` family, see `SecFilingSearchResult`).

SecFilingSearchResult.description: Shape shared by `sec_filings_search_form_type`, `sec_filings_search_symbol`, and `sec_filings_search_cik` — identical fields, one field short of `SecFilingResult` (no `hasFinancials`).

SecFilingsCompanySearchResult.description: Shape shared by `sec_filings_company_search_name`, `_symbol`, and `_cik`. Structurally identical to `IndustryClassificationResult` but kept as a separate type — one identifies a company by a search term, the other lists companies by industry classification.

SecProfileResult.description: Full SEC-registrant profile: business/mailing address, SIC classification, CEO, fiscal year end, IPO date, and more. Returned by `sec_profile()`.

SectorPeResult.description: Shape shared by `sector_pe_snapshot` (one date) and `historical_sector_pe` (a date range) — identical fields.

SectorPerformanceResult.description: Shape shared by `sector_performance_snapshot` (one date) and `historical_sector_performance` (a date range) — identical fields.

SenateNetWorthAggregatedResult.description: Aggregated net-worth totals for one member by year, grouped by asset/liability type. Returned by `senate_net_worth_aggregated()`.

SenateNetWorthResult.description: One itemized net-worth disclosure line (an asset, liability, or income entry) for one member in one filing year. Returned by `senate_net_worth()`.

SenatePositionResult.description: One congressional position a member has held, with term dates, party, and state. Returned by `senate_positions()`.

SenateProfileResult.description: A member of Congress's profile: party, state, position, years active. Despite the name, covers House members too. Returned by `senate_profile()`.

SharesFloatAllResult.description: Same as `SharesFloatResult` minus `source` — the market-wide listing's documented example doesn't include a per-row filing link.

SharesFloatResult.description: Publicly tradable share count and free float percentage for one company. Returned by `shares_float()`.

SmaResult.description: One bar of simple moving average, with its OHLCV base fields.

SplitResult.description: Shape shared by `splits` (one company's history) and `splits_calendar` (market-wide, one date range) — same rationale as `DividendResult`.

StandardDeviationResult.description: One bar of rolling standard deviation, with its OHLCV base fields.

StandardIndustrialClassificationResult.description: One SIC code and its industry title. Returned by `standard_industrial_classification_list()`.

StockListResult.description: One symbol in FMP's full tradable universe, across all asset classes and exchanges. Returned by `stock_list()`.

StockPeersResult.description: One peer company: same exchange, sector, and market-cap range. Returned by `stock_peers()`.

SymbolChangeResult.description: One recent ticker symbol change (merger, rename, split). Returned by `symbol_change()`.

TemaResult.description: One bar of triple exponential moving average, with its OHLCV base fields.

TipranksAnalystActionBreakdown.description: Nested shape of the 3 summary types' ``analystAction`` field.

TipranksAnalystDirectoryResult.description: One analyst directory entry: stable TipRanks ID, firm, star rating, and aggregate performance metrics. Returned by `tipranks_analysts()`.

TipranksPointInTimeResult.description: Shape shared by `tipranks_pit_symbol` and `tipranks_pit_analyst` — same question (a point-in-time analyst rating snapshot) at different scope (one symbol's coverage panel vs. one analyst's book), identical fields in both documented examples.

TipranksRatingResult.description: One individual TipRanks analyst rating. Returned by `tipranks_search()`.

TipranksRecommendationBreakdown.description: Nested shape of the 3 summary types' ``recommendations`` field.

TreasuryRatesResult.description: US Treasury yield curve (1-month through 30-year), one row per date. Returned by `treasury_rates()`.

UpgradesDowngradesConsensusBulkResult.description: Analyst upgrade/downgrade consensus for every company at once. Returned by `upgrades_downgrades_consensus_bulk()`.

WilliamsResult.description: One bar of Williams %R, with its OHLCV base fields.

WmaResult.description: One bar of weighted moving average, with its OHLCV base fields.
